title: Taken-over ContactInitiated rows still render the "Next reminder in ~2 days" hint, though takeover stops the sweep — the landlord waits for a reminder that never fires
detail: Takeover is offered on ContactInitiated (§7.7 any waiting state) and NULLs next_attempt_at, so automation ceases. A row taken over before batch 4 still matches the status-gated hint and promises a reminder that cannot arrive; the landlord waits on dead automation.
recommended_fix: Exclude taken-over rows from the hint: add `taken_over(call)` to the case guard (e.g. `ContactInitiated if !taken_over(call) -> ...`), with a test pinning the hint absent on a taken-over in-flight row.
